title: Police force areas, December 2023 (England and Wales, generalised, clipped)
description: The 43 territorial police force areas of England and Wales, the geography the P tables of the ONS police force area tables report against.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Police_Force_Areas_December_2023_EW_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Police_Force_Areas_December_2023_EW_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 43 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename.
